requirement.original: Three changes: (1) Remove Agent expand/collapse from inline view, (2) Agent detail page wrap sub-tools in section box, (3) Edit detail page remove redundant specialized content
requirement.clarified: Split TaskView into inline-only (no expand) and full-view (children in styled section). Remove Edit from toolFullViewRegistry.
requirement.what: Refactor Agent/Task tool rendering to have distinct inline vs full-view behavior; remove Edit diff from detail page
requirement.why: Inline view should be compact without expandable children. Detail page should show children in a visually consistent section. Edit diff duplicates Input Parameters content.

included: New TaskViewFull.tsx for detail page with styled children section
Registry update in _all.tsx (Task/Agent -> TaskViewFull, remove Edit)
i18n keys for sub-tools section header

success_criteria: Inline TaskView shows only compact status row with no chevron or expand interaction
Agent/Task detail page renders children inside a section with icon + title header matching other sections
Edit detail page shows generic layout (Description + Input + Output) with no diff view
constraints: Must use existing section styling pattern from ToolFullView.tsx
Must add i18n strings to all 9 language files
Must preserve ChildMessageBlock rendering logic (MarkdownView for agent-text, ToolView for tool-call)

root_cause_analysis.root_cause: N/A - new requirement to split inline vs full view behavior

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI refactoring with clear patterns already established in the codebase (ToolFullView section styling)

context.codebase_state: All target files recently modified and stable on main branch

TaskView.tsx.summary: 254 lines. Has expand/collapse state, TaskStatusRow (tool names + status icons + chevron), ChildMessageBlock (renders agent-text via MarkdownView, tool-call via ToolView). FilteredTool interface extracts tool-call messages.
TaskView.tsx.expand_collapse_lines: Lines 36-37 (state), 52-58 (TaskStatusRow with expand props), 61-72 (expanded children rendering), 121-130 (chevron icon), 137-145 (TouchableOpacity wrapper)

_all.tsx.summary: 85 lines. Two registries: toolViewRegistry (inline) and toolFullViewRegistry (detail). Edit, Task, Agent all in toolFullViewRegistry.

EditViewFull.tsx.summary: 38 lines. Parses old_string/new_string from tool.input, renders ToolDiffView. This info is already in Input Parameters JSON section.

ToolFullView.tsx.summary: 202 lines. Renders Description + Input + SpecializedFullView + Output + Error + EmptyOutput + RawJson(devMode). Section pattern: View(styles.section) > View(styles.sectionHeader) > Ionicons + Text(styles.sectionTitle) > content.

section_style_pattern.sectionHeader: flexDirection: row, alignItems: center, marginBottom: 12, gap: 8

development_approach.strategy: Three-file change: simplify TaskView.tsx (remove expand), create TaskViewFull.tsx (new), update _all.tsx (registry)

TaskView.tsx_changes: Remove useState for expanded, useCallback for toggle
Remove chevron icon and TouchableOpacity wrapper from TaskStatusRow
Remove ChildMessageBlock component (move to TaskViewFull or shared)
Remove unused imports (TouchableOpacity, MarkdownView, ToolView, Message)
Remove unused styles (chevronContainer, childrenContainer, childText, childTool)
TaskViewFull.tsx_design: Import toolFullViewStyles from ../ToolFullView for section styling
Import ChildMessageBlock from TaskView (or inline it)
Import Ionicons for section header icon
Import t() for i18n section title
Render: View(section) > View(sectionHeader) > Ionicons + Text(title) > children map with ChildMessageBlock
Also show TaskStatusRow as summary above the children section
_all.tsx_changes: Change toolFullViewRegistry: Task: TaskViewFull, Agent: TaskViewFull

development_approach.validation_approach: Playwright on dev.life-ai.app: (1) verify inline Agent shows status row without chevron, (2) tap Agent to open detail page and verify children in styled section, (3) tap Edit to open detail page and verify no diff view, only generic sections
